claims.text: Absorbable (gut, Vicryl): deep layers and oral mucosa.

claims.text: Non-absorbable (nylon, silk, polypropylene): outer skin layers; must be removed.

claims.text: Size: smaller number (1-0) = thicker, stronger strand; larger number (6-0) = finer strand for thin tissue and the face.
claims.quote: size: smaller numbers (1-0) = larger strand, more tensile strength, larger needles - thick tissue, tension-bearing, cosmetics ⍉ primary; larger numbers (6-0) = smaller strand/needles - thin tissue - cosmetics (face)

claims.text: Drive the needle in at 90° to evert the wound edges.
claims.quote: drive needle into skin @ 90° → proper wound edge eversion

claims.text: Close deep layers first, then bisect the wound and start in the middle to avoid a “dog ear”.
claims.quote: “divide and conquer”: deep layers FIRST (close dead space + restore strength, ⍉ cosmetic) - outer layer: test-drive approximation - BISECT wound, start in middle → outward - starting at one end → “dog ear”
